150809.desc_cn: 对敌方全体造成等同于远坂凛#1[i]%攻击力的量子属性伤害。之后，消耗#2[i]点【宝石能量】对敌方随机单体目标额外造成等同于远坂凛#3[i]%攻击力的量子属性伤害，重复直至【宝石能量】不足#2[i]点或无当前生命值大于0的敌方目标，最多重复#6[i]轮。施放时，若当前战技点大于#4[i]点，将战技点消耗至#4[i]点，每消耗1点立即获得#5[i]点【宝石能量】。

150901.name: Halfhearted Blow
150901.desc: Deals Lightning DMG equal to #1[i]% of Gilgamesh's ATK to one designated enemy.
150901.desc_cn: 对指定敌方单体造成等同于吉尔伽美什#1[i]%攻击力的雷属性伤害。

150902.name: Gate of Babylon
150902.desc:
Gains "King's Acknowledgement," allowing this unit to ignore #5[i]% of the target's DEF when dealing DMG, lasting for #6[i] turn(s).
Deals Lightning DMG equal to #1[i]% of Gilgamesh's ATK to one designated enemy, and deals Lightning DMG equal to #2[i]% of Gilgamesh's ATK to adjacent targets.
150902.desc_cn:
获得【王来承认】，使自身造成伤害时无视目标#5[i]%的防御力，持续#6[i]回合。
对指定敌方单体造成等同于吉尔伽美什#1[i]%攻击力的雷属性伤害，对相邻目标造成等同于吉尔伽美什#2[i]%攻击力的雷属性伤害。

150903.name: Enuma Elish
150903.desc: Deals Lightning DMG equal to #1[i]% of Gilgamesh's ATK to all enemies, and additionally deals #3[i] instance(s) of DMG, with each instance dealing Lightning DMG equal to #2[i]% of Gilgamesh's ATK to one random enemy.
150903.desc_cn: 对敌方全体造成等同于吉尔伽美什#1[i]%攻击力的雷属性伤害。并额外造成#3[i]次伤害，每次对敌方随机单体造成等同于吉尔伽美什#2[i]%攻击力的雷属性伤害。

150904.name: "Amuse Me to the Fullest"
150904.desc:
When a teammate uses their Ultimate, Gilgamesh gains "King's Burden," which increases Ultimate DMG dealt by this unit by #3[i]%, lasting for #1[i] turn(s).
Initially, automatically uses Basic ATK at the start of this unit's turn. When another ally target takes action, Gilgamesh gains 1 point of "Interest." For each point of "Interest" in possession, increases this unit's SPD by #4[i]%.
When "Interest" reaches #2[i] for the first time, enters the "Interest Piqued!" state. In that state, can only use Skill, lasting for the entire battle. After using Skill, clears this unit's "Interest."
150904.desc_cn:
我方队友施放终结技时，吉尔伽美什获得【王来背负】，使自身造成的终结技伤害提高#3[i]%，持续#1[i]回合。
初始自身回合开始时自动施放普攻。我方其他目标行动时，吉尔伽美什获得1点【兴致】，每拥有1点【兴致】使自身速度提高#4[i]%。
当【兴致】首次达到#2[i]点时，进入【来兴致了！】状态，该状态下仅能施放战技，且持续整场战斗。施放战技后，清空自身【兴致】。

150905.name: "I Grant You Permission To Strike"
150905.desc:
When Gilgamesh or Saber attacks, the attack tally increases by 1. After any unit attacks, if the attack tally reaches #5[i], Gilgamesh and Saber launch Joint Follow-Up ATK, dealing Lightning DMG equal to #1[i]% of Gilgamesh's ATK and Wind DMG equal to #2[i]% of Saber's ATK to all enemies, respectively. Then, Gilgamesh gains #3[i] "Interest." Saber regenerates a fixed #4[i] Energy, and the next time she uses Ultimate, the DMG dealt becomes #6[i]% of the original DMG.
After using Joint Follow-Up ATK, resets the attack tally.
150905.desc_cn:
吉尔伽美什或Saber攻击时累计1点攻击计数，任意单位攻击后若累计攻击计数达到#5[i]，吉尔伽美什和Saber发动连携追加攻击，对敌方全体分别造成等同于吉尔伽美什#1[i]%攻击力的雷属性伤害以及Saber#2[i]%攻击力的风属性伤害，随后吉尔伽美什获得#3[i]点【兴致】，Saber固定恢复#4[i]点能量并使自身下一次施放终结技时，造成的伤害为原伤害的#6[i]%。
施放连携追加攻击后清空累计攻击计数。

150906.name: Attack
150906.desc: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.
150906.desc_cn: 攻击敌人，进入战斗后削弱敌方目标对应属性韧性。

150907.name: Enkidu
150907.desc:
After using Technique, creates 1 Special Dimension lasting for #1[i] second(s). Enemies in the Special Dimension enter the "King's Permission" state. Enemies in the "King's Permission" state will cease all actions.
When entering combat by actively attacking an enemy in the "King's Permission" state, causes all enemies in the "King's Permission" state to enter combat, and deals Lightning DMG equal to #2[i]% of Gilgamesh's ATK to all enemies after entering combat. Gilgamesh also immediately gains #3[i] "Interest." Only 1 Dimension Effect created by allies can exist at the same time.
150907.desc_cn:
使用秘技后，制造1片持续#1[i]秒的特殊领域，处于特殊领域内的敌人陷入【王来允许】状态，【王来允许】状态下的敌人会停止所有行动。
主动攻击陷入【王来允许】的敌人进入战斗时，使所有处于【王来允许】状态的敌人同时进入战斗，进入战斗后对敌方全体造成等同于吉尔伽美什#2[i]%攻击力的雷属性伤害，且吉尔伽美什立即获得#3[i]点【兴致】。我方制造的领域效果最多存在1个。

151001.name: Enkindle the First Lodestar
151001.desc: Deals Fire DMG equal to #1[i]% of Himeko • Nova's ATK to one enemy.
151001.desc_cn: 对敌方单体造成等同于姬子•启行#1[i]%攻击力的火属性伤害。

151002.name: Upraise the Vanward Cresset
151002.desc: After using Skill, immediately recovers all Assist Skill uses. Himeko • Nova gains "Navigator's Semaphore," lasting for #2[i] turn(s). This duration decreases by 1 at the start of Himeko • Nova's every turn. When Himeko • Nova has "Navigator's Semaphore," DMG dealt by all allies increases by #1[i]%. At the start of every turn, immediately recovers 1 Assist Skill use.
151002.desc_cn: 施放战技后立即恢复所有助战技使用次数，姬子•启行获得【领航旗语】，持续#2[i]回合，姬子•启行每回合开始时持续回合数减1。当姬子•启行拥有【领航旗语】时，我方全体造成的伤害提高#1[i]%，每个回合开始时，立即恢复1次助战技使用次数。

151003.name: We, Too, Stride the Stars
151003.desc:
Immediately takes control of "Starblazer." "Starblazer" can launch "Hyperluminal Particle Beam" against enemies 6 times, or consume "Source Energy" to launch "Orbital Annihilation Pulse," dealing Fire DMG up to #9[i]% of Himeko • Nova's ATK to one designated enemy, and Fire DMG up to #10[i]% of Himeko • Nova's ATK to other targets.
When the uses of "Hyperluminal Particle Beam" are depleted, automatically launches "Orbital Annihilation Pulse," followed by Final Hit, dealing #6[i] instance(s) of DMG, with each instance dealing Fire DMG equal to #7[i]% of Himeko • Nova's ATK to one random enemy.
When "Hyperluminal Particle Beam" or "Orbital Annihilation Pulse" deals fatal damage to all enemies on the field, or when enemy HP can no longer be reduced, immediately launches Final Hit.
151003.desc_cn:
立即操控「拓星者」，「拓星者」拥有可对敌方发动6次的【超频粒子光束】或消耗【源能】发动的【轨道歼灭脉冲】，对指定敌方单体最多造成等同于姬子•启行#9[i]%攻击力的火属性伤害，对其他目标最多造成等同于姬子•启行#10[i]%攻击力的火属性伤害。
当【超频粒子光束】次数耗尽时，会自动发动【轨道歼灭脉冲】，随后发动最后一击，造成#6[i]次伤害，每次伤害对敌方随机单体造成等同于姬子•启行#7[i]%攻击力的火属性伤害。
施放【超频粒子光束】或【轨道歼灭脉冲】对场上所有敌方造成致命伤害或敌方无法被继续削减生命值时，会立即发动最后一击。

151004.name: Of Fire and Far Faring
151004.desc:
While Himeko • Nova is on the field, immediately deploys the Territory "Starblazer Visioscape," summoning "Starblazer" to the field and granting all ally characters 1 Assist Skill use. Ally characters can use Assist Skill to call upon "Starblazer" to attack enemies.
Using Assist Skill is considered as Himeko • Nova using her Skill. Himeko • Nova gains #2[i]% increased All-Type RES PEN and #1[i]% increased CRIT DMG. When attacking, can ignore Weakness Types to reduce enemy Toughness. When breaking Weakness, triggers the Fire Weakness Break effect.
When ally characters other than Himeko • Nova use their Assist Skill, regenerates #3[i] Energy for them.
151004.desc_cn:
姬子•启行在场时立即展开境界【拓星视界】，场上出现「拓星者」，并使我方全体角色获得1次助战技使用次数。我方角色可使用助战技呼唤「拓星者」攻击敌人。
使用助战技视为姬子•启行施放了战技，姬子•启行获得全属性抗性穿透提高#2[i]%、暴击伤害提高#1[i]%，攻击时可无视弱点属性削减敌方韧性，击破弱点时，触发火属性的弱点击破效果。
除姬子•启行外的我方角色使用助战技时，会使其恢复#3[i]点能量。

151006.name: Attack
151006.desc: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.
151006.desc_cn: 攻击敌人，进入战斗后削弱敌方目标对应属性韧性。

151007.name: Starcharter Cruise
151007.desc:
When Himeko • Nova is in the team, increases the max Technique Points by 3.
After using Technique, enters the "Cruise" state for #1[i] seconds. Actively using the Technique consumes 2 Technique Points and immediately attacks all enemies within a certain range. After entering combat, immediately uses Skill 1 time at the start of each wave.
If attacking a Normal Enemy, immediately defeats them without entering combat. No Technique Points are consumed if no enemies are hit.
151007.desc_cn:
姬子•启行在队伍中时，使秘技点上限提高3点。
使用秘技后进入持续#1[i]秒的【巡航】状态，主动施放秘技消耗2点秘技点，立即攻击一定范围内的所有敌人。进入战斗后，每个波次开始时立即施放1次战技。
若攻击普通敌人则立即将其消灭，不会进入战斗。未击中敌人时不消耗秘技点。

151008.name: Hyperluminal Particle Beam
151008.desc: Deals Fire DMG equal to #1[i]% of Himeko • Nova's ATK to all enemies and gains #2[i] point(s) of "Source Energy." A maximum of #3[i] "Source Energy" can be held.
151008.desc_cn: 对敌方全体造成等同于姬子•启行#1[i]%攻击力的火属性伤害，获得#2[i]点【源能】，【源能】最多获得#3[i]个。

151009.name: Orbital Annihilation Pulse
151009.desc: Consumes 1 point of "Source Energy" to deal Fire DMG equal to #1[i]% of Himeko • Nova's ATK to all enemies. When the current "Source Energy" is more than 1, for every #2[i] point(s) of "Source Energy" consumed, additionally deals 1 instance of Fire DMG equal to #3[i]% of Himeko • Nova's ATK to one random enemy.
151009.desc_cn: 消耗1点【源能】对敌方全体造成等同于姬子•启行#1[i]%攻击力的火属性伤害。当前【源能】大于1点时，每消耗#2[i]点【源能】，额外对敌方随机单体造成1次等同于姬子•启行#3[i]%攻击力的火属性伤害。

151014.name: We, Too, Stride the Stars
151014.desc: Deals #2[i] instance(s) of DMG, each dealing Fire DMG to one random enemy.
151014.desc_cn: 造成#2[i]次伤害，每次伤害对敌方随机单体造成火属性伤害。

151022.name: Trailblaze, By Your Side
151022.desc:
Deals Fire DMG equal to #1[i]% of Himeko • Nova's ATK to all enemies, and additionally deals #2[i] instances of DMG, with each instance dealing Fire DMG equal to #3[i]% of Himeko • Nova's ATK to one random enemy. When used by Himeko • Nova, deals Fire DMG equal to #4[i]% of Himeko • Nova's ATK to all enemies, and additionally deals #5[i] instances of DMG, with each instance dealing Fire DMG equal to #6[i]% of Himeko • Nova's ATK to one random enemy.
If the user is a Trailblaze Companions character other than Himeko • Nova, then depending on the user, Himeko • Nova additionally gains 1 of the Special Effects.
The extra Assist Skill via all Special Effects can be launched up to #8[i] time(s) per battle, and this count is reset after Himeko • Nova uses her Ultimate.
151022.desc_cn:
对敌方全体造成等同于姬子•启行#1[i]%攻击力的火属性伤害，额外造成#2[i]次伤害，每次伤害对敌方随机单体造成等同于姬子•启行#3[i]%攻击力的火属性伤害。姬子•启行使用时，对敌方全体造成等同于姬子•启行#4[i]%攻击力的火属性伤害，额外造成#5[i]次伤害，每次伤害对敌方随机单体造成等同于姬子•启行#6[i]%攻击力的火属性伤害。
若使用者为姬子•启行外的开拓同行角色，则根据使用者的不同，姬子•启行额外获得特殊效果的其中1种。
所有特殊效果发动的额外助战技单场战斗中最多发动#8[i]次，姬子•启行施放终结技后刷新发动次数。

151025.name: Companion Protocol: Verdict
151025.desc: Enters the "Companion Protocol: Verdict" state. Increases DMG dealt by Himeko • Nova by #8[i]%, and additionally increases her Ultimate DMG dealt by #10[i]%. After Himeko • Nova's teammates actively use their Ultimate #9[i] time(s), Himeko • Nova immediately launches 1 Assist Skill against enemies at no cost.
151025.desc_cn: 进入【同行协议：裁决】状态。姬子•启行造成的伤害提高#8[i]%，造成的终结技伤害额外提高#10[i]%。姬子•启行的队友主动施放#9[i]次终结技后，姬子•启行立即对敌方发动1次无消耗的助战技。

151026.name: Companion Protocol: Decimation
151026.desc: Enters the "Companion Protocol: Decimation" state. Increases all allies' CRIT DMG by #8[i]%, and additionally increases the CRIT DMG dealt by Skill by #10[i]%. For every 1 enemy target hit by allies, gains 1 Charge. When Charge reaches #9[i], consumes all Charge, and Himeko • Nova immediately launches 1 Assist Skill against enemies at no cost. This instance of Assist Skill cannot grant Charge.
151026.desc_cn: 进入【同行协议：歼破】状态。我方全体暴击伤害提高#8[i]%，战技造成的暴击伤害额外提高#10[i]%。我方每击中1名敌方目标均可获得1点充能，当充能到达#9[i]点后消耗所有充能，姬子•启行立即对敌方发动1次无消耗的助战技。本次助战技无法获得充能。

151201.name: The Sea Sings in My Key
151201.desc: Deals Wind DMG equal to #1[i]% of Robin • Summeretto's Max HP to one enemy.
151201.desc_cn: 对敌方单体造成等同于知更鸟•晴歌#1[i]%生命上限的风属性伤害。

151202.name: Summer Strums the Soul
151202.desc: Summons the memosprite "Summer Songbirds" Bessie. If any member of the "Summer Songbirds" is already on the field, restores their HP by an amount equal to #1[i]% of "Summer Songbirds'" Max HP, and gains #2[i] Vibes.
151202.desc_cn: 召唤忆灵「晴空乐手」贝茜。若任意「晴空乐手」已在场，为其回复等同于「晴空乐手」生命上限#1[i]%的生命值，并获得#2[i]点气氛值。

151203.name: Ascend That Rhapsody in Blue
151203.desc: Advances the action of one designated ally character (excluding Robin • Summeretto) by #1[i]% and regenerates a fixed amount of Energy equal to #3[f1]% of their Max Energy. Then, grants them the "Special Guest" effect. When the "Special Guest" character or their summon attacks, they additionally grant Robin • Summeretto #2[i] Vibes but cannot make other friendly targets gain the action advance effect. This lasts for 2 turn(s), and its duration decreases by 1 at the start of this character's turn.
151203.desc_cn: 使除知更鸟•晴歌外的指定我方单体角色行动提前#1[i]%并固定恢复等同于#3[f1]%能量上限的能量。随后使其获得【特邀嘉宾】效果，持有【特邀嘉宾】的角色及其召唤物攻击时额外使知更鸟•晴歌获得#2[i]点气氛值，且无法使其他友方目标获得行动提前效果，持续2回合。该角色每回合开始时持续回合数减1。

151204.name: Wings Heed No Borders
151204.desc:
Memosprite "Summer Songbirds" has an initial Max HP equal to #1[i]% of Robin • Summeretto's Max HP and an initial SPD equal to #2[i]% of Robin • Summeretto's SPD. When an ally target uses an attack, or when they provide healing or Shield for the first time in any target's turn, Robin • Summeretto gains Vibes by 1 point, capped at #5[i]. While "Summer Songbirds" Bessie is on the field, if Robin • Summeretto's Vibes is #6[i] or higher, immediately summons "Summer Songbirds" Drummie, and if Vibes is #7[i] or higher, immediately summons "Summer Songbirds" Paddie. When all "Summer Songbirds" take the stage, dispels all Crowd Control debuffs inflicted upon Robin • Summeretto and the "Summer Songbirds", starts the "Fever" state, and deploys a Zone. When ally targets deal DMG within the Zone, they ignore a percentage of enemy targets' DEF equal to (#8[f1]% + Vibes × #9[f1]%).
While in the "Fever" state, Robin • Summeretto and the "Summer Songbirds" are immune to Crowd Control debuffs. Robin • Summeretto will not enter her turn until the "Fever" state ends.
151204.desc_cn:
忆灵「晴空乐手」初始拥有等同于知更鸟•晴歌#1[i]%生命上限的生命上限和等同于知更鸟•晴歌#2[i]%速度的速度。我方目标施放攻击时，或在任意目标回合第一次提供治疗效果或护盾时，知更鸟•晴歌获得1点气氛值，上限#5[i]点。「晴空乐手」贝茜在场时，若知更鸟•晴歌的气氛值大于等于#6[i]点，立即召唤「晴空乐手」啾米，若气氛值大于等于#7[i]点，立即召唤「晴空乐手」派丁。当「晴空乐手」全员登台后，解除知更鸟•晴歌与「晴空乐手」陷入的所有控制类负面状态、进入【Fever】状态并展开结界，结界内我方目标造成伤害时无视敌方目标（#8[f1]%+气氛值*#9[f1]%）防御力。
处于【Fever】状态时，知更鸟•晴歌与「晴空乐手」免疫控制类负面状态，【Fever】状态结束前知更鸟•晴歌不会进入自己的回合。

151206.name: Attack
151206.desc: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.
151206.desc_cn: 攻击敌人，进入战斗后削弱敌方目标对应属性韧性。

151207.name: We Are the Melody
151207.desc: After using Technique, advances action by #3[i]% at the start of the next battle, immediately gains #1[i] Vibes, and increases all allies' DMG dealt by #2[i]%, lasting for 2 turn(s).
151207.desc_cn: 使用秘技后，使下一次战斗开始时行动提前#3[i]%，立即获得#1[i]点气氛值，并使我方全体造成的伤害提高#2[i]%，持续2回合。

151301.name: Dead Center, the Torrent Hits
151301.desc: Deals Quantum DMG equal to #1[i]% of Aventurine • Waveflair's ATK to one designated enemy.
151301.desc_cn: 对指定敌方单体造成等同于砂金•戏浪#1[i]%攻击力的量子属性伤害。

151302.name: Kill Shot, the Sands Boil
151302.desc: Deals Quantum DMG equal to #1[i]% of Aventurine • Waveflair's ATK to all enemies. Gains #2[i] Punchline and #3[i] "Fervor."
151302.desc_cn: 对敌方全体造成等同于砂金•戏浪#1[i]%攻击力的量子属性伤害，获得#2[i]个笑点和#3[i]点【热意】。

151303.name: Grand Slam, Crest That High Tide
151303.desc: Deals Quantum DMG equal to #1[i]% of Aventurine • Waveflair's ATK to all enemies. Gains #3[i] Punchline and #2[i] "Fervor." Increases this unit's SPD by #4[i]%, lasting for #5[i] turn(s).
151303.desc_cn: 对敌方全体造成等同于砂金•戏浪#1[i]%攻击力的量子属性伤害，获得#3[i]个笑点和#2[i]点【热意】。并使自身速度提高#4[i]%，持续#5[i]回合。

151304.name: Ante Up, the Abyss Answers
151304.desc:
The duration of Aventurine • Waveflair's "Certified Banger" increases by 1 turn. After a teammate uses an attack, Aventurine • Waveflair gains #7[i] "Fervor" and #6[i] Punchline. "Fervor" is capped at #4[i] points.
When "Fervor" reaches #1[i], Aventurine • Waveflair uses 1 instance of "Cheers! To Summer's Blaze" that takes into account a fixed amount of #5[i] Punchline. After this use, the next Elation Skill used by this unit in the Aha Instant gets enhanced into "All In! To Summer's Blaze."
While Aventurine • Waveflair holds "Certified Banger," Skill additionally deals #2[i]% Quantum Elation DMG to all enemies, and Ultimate additionally deals #3[i]% Quantum Elation DMG to all enemies.
151304.desc_cn:
砂金•戏浪的【好活当赏】的持续时间增加1回合。队友施放攻击后，砂金•戏浪获得#7[i]点【热意】以及#6[i]个笑点，【热意】上限为#4[i]点。
【热意】达到#1[i]点时，砂金•戏浪会立即施放1次固定计入#5[i]笑点的【举杯！敬炽烈一夏】，并在施放后使自身下一次在阿哈时刻中施放的欢愉技强化为【All in！敬炽烈一夏】。
砂金•戏浪持有【好活当赏】时，战技额外对敌方全体造成#2[i]%量子属性欢愉伤害，终结技额外对敌方全体造成#3[i]%量子属性欢愉伤害。

151306.name: Attack
151306.desc: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.
151306.desc_cn: 攻击敌人，进入战斗后削弱敌方目标对应属性韧性。

151307.name: Make Waves in Still Waters
151307.desc: Moves forward rapidly for a set distance, attacking all enemies in contact and blocking all incoming attacks. After entering combat via actively attacking enemies, deals Quantum DMG to all enemies equal to #1[i]% of Aventurine • Waveflair's ATK, and gains #2[i] "Fervor" and #3[i] "Certified Banger." Technique Points are not consumed if no enemies are hit.
151307.desc_cn: 快速向前移动一段距离并攻击接触到的敌人，在快速移动的过程中可抵挡敌人的所有攻击。主动攻击敌人进入战斗后，对敌方全体造成等同于砂金•戏浪#1[i]%攻击力的量子属性伤害，并使自身获得#2[i]点【热意】和#3[i]点【好活当赏】。未击中敌人时不消耗秘技点。

151320.name: Cheers! To Summer's Blaze
151320.desc: Deals #1[i]% Quantum Elation DMG to all enemies, and additionally deals #2[i] instance(s) of DMG, with each instance dealing #3[f1]% Quantum Elation DMG to one random enemy.
151320.desc_cn: 对敌方全体造成#1[i]%量子属性欢愉伤害，并额外造成#2[i]次伤害，每次伤害对随机敌方单体造成#3[f1]%量子属性欢愉伤害。

151321.name: All In! To Summer's Blaze
151321.desc: Deals #1[i]% Quantum Elation DMG to all enemies, and additionally deals #3[i] instances of DMG, with each instance dealing #4[f1]% Quantum Elation DMG to one random enemy. Consumes all "Fervor" upon use. For every 1 point of "Fervor" consumed, additionally deals 1 instance of #2[f1]% Quantum Elation DMG to one random enemy.
151321.desc_cn: 对敌方全体造成#1[i]%量子属性欢愉伤害，并额外造成#3[i]次伤害，每次伤害对随机敌方单体造成#4[f1]%量子属性欢愉伤害。施放时会消耗所有【热意】，每消耗1点【热意】都会额外对随机敌方单体造成1次#2[f1]%量子属性欢愉伤害。

800101.name: Farewell Hit
800101.desc: Deals Physical DMG equal to #1[i]% of the Trailblazer's ATK to one designated enemy.
800101.desc_cn: 对指定敌方单体造成等同于开拓者#1[i]%攻击力的物理属性伤害。

800102.name: RIP Home Run
800102.desc: Deals Physical DMG equal to #1[i]% of the Trailblazer's ATK to one designated enemy and enemies adjacent to it.
800102.desc_cn: 对指定敌方单体及其相邻目标造成等同于开拓者#1[i]%攻击力的物理属性伤害。

800103.name: Stardust Ace
800103.desc:
Choose between two attack modes to deliver a full strike.
"Blowout: Farewell Hit" deals Physical DMG equal to #1[i]% of the Trailblazer's ATK to one designated enemy.
"Blowout: RIP Home Run" deals Physical DMG equal to #2[i]% of the Trailblazer's ATK to one designated enemy, and Physical DMG equal to #3[i]% of the Trailblazer's ATK to enemies adjacent to it.
800103.desc_cn:
在两种攻击模式中选择其一挥出全力一击。
【全胜•再见安打】：对指定敌方单体造成等同于开拓者#1[i]%攻击力的物理属性伤害。
【全胜•安息全垒打】：对指定敌方单体造成等同于开拓者#2[i]%攻击力的物理属性伤害，并对其相邻目标造成等同于开拓者#3[i]%攻击力的物理属性伤害。

与处于时停状态下的敌人进入战斗后，使敌方全体行动延后#2[i]%，随后对敌方全体造成等同于开拓者#3[i]%攻击力的冰属性伤害。
我方制造的领域效果最多存在1个。

800808.name: Together, We Script Tomorrow!
800808.desc: Consumes 1 stack of "Epic" to dispel all Crowd Control debuffs on Mem. Trailblazer and Mem launch a Joint ATK, dealing Ice DMG to all enemies equal to #1[i]% of Trailblazer's ATK and #2[i]% of Mem's ATK respectively. Then, Mem gains #3[i]% Charge.
800808.desc_cn: 消耗1层【史诗】，解除迷迷陷入的所有控制类负面状态。开拓者与迷迷发起连携攻击，对敌方全体分别造成等同于开拓者#1[i]%攻击力以及迷迷#2[i]%攻击力的冰属性伤害，随后使迷迷获得#3[i]%充能。

800809.name: I Choose You!
800809.desc: Summons the memosprite Mem. If Mem is already on the field, restores Mem's HP, and grants Mem Charge.
800809.desc_cn: 召唤忆灵迷迷。若迷迷已在场，为迷迷回复生命值，并使迷迷获得充能。

800901.name: Make Some Noise
800901.desc: Deals Lightning DMG equal to #1[i]% of Trailblazer's ATK to one designated enemy.
800901.desc_cn: 对指定敌方单体造成等同于开拓者#1[i]%攻击力的雷属性伤害。

800902.name: Let the Storm Rage On
800902.desc: Deals Lightning DMG equal to #1[i]% of the Trailblazer's ATK to all enemies and gains #2[i] point(s) of "Certified Banger."
800902.desc_cn: 对敌方全体造成等同于开拓者#1[i]%攻击力的雷属性伤害，获得#2[i]点【好活当赏】。

800903.name: May the Trailblaze Fly You Starward
800903.desc:
Gains #6[i] Punchline point(s). Increases the CRIT DMG of one designated ally by #1[i]% for #2[i] turn(s), and dispels Crowd Control debuffs on them.
If the target has Elation Skill, they additionally gain #4[i] point(s) of "Certified Banger" and immediately use their Elation Skill 1 time, taking into account a fixed amount of #5[i] Punchline point(s). If the enemy target is defeated before the Elation Skill is unleashed, then the Elation Skill is instead launched on a newly entering enemy target.
If the target does not have Elation Skill, their action advances by #3[i]%.
800903.desc_cn:
获得#6[i]个笑点，使指定我方单体暴击伤害提高#1[i]%，持续#2[i]回合，并解除该目标的控制类负面状态。
若目标拥有欢愉技，目标额外获得#4[i]点【好活当赏】，并使其立即施放1次固定计入#5[i]笑点的欢愉技，若欢愉技施放前敌方目标被消灭则对新入场的敌方目标发动欢愉技。
若目标不拥有欢愉技，使其行动提前#3[i]%。

800904.name: That Smile Hits Different
800904.desc:
After using an attack, regenerates a fixed amount of #1[i] Energy and gains #2[i] Punchline point(s).
When the Trailblazer holds "Certified Banger," their Skill additionally deals #3[i]% Lightning Elation DMG to all enemies. This DMG is calculated using the highest "Certified Banger" value among all allies.
800904.desc_cn:
施放攻击后，固定恢复#1[i]点能量并获得#2[i]个笑点。
开拓者持有【好活当赏】时，战技对敌方全体额外造成#3[i]%的雷属性欢愉伤害，此伤害使用我方最高的【好活当赏】数值计算。

800906.name: Attack
800906.desc: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.
800906.desc_cn: 攻击敌人，进入战斗后削弱敌方目标对应属性韧性。

800907.name: We Are So Back!
800907.desc:
After using Technique, randomly gains 1 of the following effects:
A low chance to gain "Hearty Laughter": Increases Elation by #1[i]%.
A high chance to gain "Irrepressible Laughter": Increases Elation by #3[i]%.
When the next battle begins, increases all allies' Elation stat by the corresponding amount for #5[i] turn(s).
800907.desc_cn:
使用秘技后随机获得以下1种效果：
小概率获得【开怀大笑】：欢愉度提高#1[i]%。
大概率获得【忍俊不禁】：欢愉度提高#3[i]%。
下一次战斗开始时，使我方全体提高对应数值的欢愉度，持续#5[i]回合。

800920.desc_cn: 造成#1[i]次伤害，每次对敌方随机单体造成#2[i]%的雷属性欢愉伤害。最后造成#3[i]%的雷属性欢愉伤害，由敌方全体均分。

1100402.name: Edge of the Void
1100402.desc: Deals Imaginary DMG equal to #1[i]% of Welt's ATK to one designated enemy and additionally deals DMG 4 times, with each time dealing Imaginary DMG equal to #1[i]% of Welt's ATK to one random enemy. On hit, there is a #2[i]% base chance to reduce the enemy's SPD by #3[i]% for #4[i] turn(s).
1100402.desc_cn: 对指定敌方单体造成等同于瓦尔特#1[i]%攻击力的虚数属性伤害，并额外造成4次伤害。每次伤害对敌方随机单体造成等同于瓦尔特#1[i]%攻击力的虚数属性伤害。攻击命中时有#2[i]%的基础概率使受到攻击的敌方目标速度降低#3[i]%，持续#4[i]回合。

1100403.name: Synthetic Black Hole
1100403.desc:
Deals Imaginary DMG equal to #1[i]% of Welt's ATK to all enemies. Has a #3[i]% base chance to Imprison hit enemy targets for 1 turn.
While Imprisoned, enemy targets have their actions delayed by #2[f1]% and their SPD reduced by #4[i]%. After using his Ultimate, inflicts the "Weightless" state on all enemies. When targets in "Weightless" state get attacked, their actions are delayed by #5[f1]%. This effect can trigger up to #6[i] time(s) per target per turn. "Weightless" lasts for #7[i] turn(s).
1100403.desc_cn:
对敌方全体造成等同于瓦尔特#1[i]%攻击力的虚数属性伤害，有#3[i]%的基础概率使受到攻击的敌方目标陷入禁锢状态，持续1回合。
禁锢状态下，敌方目标行动延后#2[f1]%，速度降低#4[i]%。施放终结技后使敌方全体陷入【失重】状态，【失重】状态下的敌方目标受到攻击时行动延后#5[f1]%，该效果每个目标每回合内最多触发#6[i]次，【失重】状态持续#7[i]回合。

1100404.name: Time Distortion
1100404.desc: Enemy targets in the "Weightless" state have their DEF reduced by #2[i]% and their SPD reduced by #3[i]%. When Welt attacks an enemy that is already Slowed, he additionally deals Imaginary Additional DMG equal to #1[i]% of his ATK to the enemy.
1100404.desc_cn: 处于【失重】状态下的敌方目标防御力降低#2[i]%，速度降低#3[i]%。瓦尔特击中处于减速状态的敌方目标时，额外造成1次等同于瓦尔特#1[i]%攻击力的虚数属性附加伤害。

1100406.name: Attack

1100406.desc_cn: 攻击敌人，进入战斗后削弱敌方目标对应属性韧性。

1100407.name: Gravitational Imprisonment
1100407.desc:
After using Welt's Technique, create a Special Dimension that lasts for #4[i] second(s). Enemies in this Special Dimension have their movement speed reduced by #5[i]%. After entering combat with enemies in the Special Dimension, there is a #1[i]% base chance to Imprison the enemies for 1 turn.
Imprisoned enemies have their actions delayed by #2[i]% and SPD reduced by #3[i]%. Only 1 Dimension Effect created by allies can exist at the same time.
1100407.desc_cn:
使用秘技后，制造1片持续#4[i]秒的特殊领域。处于特殊领域内的敌人移动速度降低#5[i]%。与处于特殊领域内的敌人进入战斗后，有#1[i]%的基础概率使敌方目标陷入禁锢状态，持续1回合。
禁锢状态下，敌方目标行动延后#2[i]%，速度降低#3[i]%。我方制造的领域效果最多存在1个。

1100501.name: Midnight Tumult
1100501.desc: Deals Lightning DMG equal to #1[i]% of Kafka's ATK to one designated enemy.
1100501.desc_cn: 对指定敌方单体造成等同于卡芙卡#1[i]%攻击力的雷属性伤害。

1100502.name: Caressing Moonlight
1100502.desc:
Deals Lightning DMG equal to #1[i]% of Kafka's ATK to one designated enemy and Lightning DMG equal to #3[i]% of Kafka's ATK to adjacent targets.
If the designated enemy or the adjacent targets are currently afflicted with DoT, all DoTs currently placed on those enemies immediately produces DMG equal to #2[i]% or #4[i]% of the original DMG.
1100502.desc_cn:
对指定敌方单体造成等同于卡芙卡#1[i]%攻击力的雷属性伤害，同时对其相邻目标造成等同于卡芙卡#3[i]%攻击力的雷属性伤害。
若指定敌方单体或相邻目标处于持续伤害状态，其当前承受的所有持续伤害立即产生相当于原伤害#2[i]%或#4[i]%的伤害。

1100503.name: Twilight Trill
1100503.desc:
Deals Lightning DMG equal to #1[i]% of Kafka's ATK to all enemies, with a #2[i]% base chance for enemy targets hit to become Shocked and immediately take DMG from their current DoT debuff(s), equal to #5[i]% of the original DMG. Shock lasts for #3[i] turn(s).
While Shocked, enemy targets receive Lightning DoT equal to #4[i]% of Kafka's ATK at the beginning of each turn.
1100503.desc_cn:
对敌方全体造成等同于卡芙卡#1[i]%攻击力的雷属性伤害，有#2[i]%的基础概率使受到攻击的敌方目标陷入触电状态，并使其当前承受的持续伤害类负面状态立即产生相当于原伤害#5[i]%的伤害。触电状态持续#3[i]回合。
触电状态下，敌方目标每回合开始时受到等同于卡芙卡#4[i]%攻击力的雷属性持续伤害。

1100504.name: Gentle but Cruel
1100504.desc: After Kafka's teammate uses an attack on an enemy target, Kafka immediately launches Follow-Up ATK and deals Lightning DMG equal to #1[i]% of Kafka's ATK to the primary target, with a #2[i]% base chance to inflict Shock (equivalent to that applied by her Ultimate) on the attacked enemy target for #3[i] turns. This effect can trigger up to #5[i] time(s), #4[i] of which can be regained at the end of Kafka's turn.
1100504.desc_cn: 当卡芙卡的队友对敌方目标施放攻击后，卡芙卡立即发动追加攻击，对主目标造成等同于卡芙卡#1[i]%攻击力的雷属性伤害，并有#2[i]%的基础概率使受到攻击的敌方目标陷入与终结技相同的触电状态，持续#3[i]回合。该效果最多可触发#5[i]次，卡芙卡回合结束时恢复#4[i]次。

1100506.name: Attack

1100506.desc_cn: 攻击敌人，进入战斗后削弱敌方目标对应属性韧性。

1100507.name: Mercy Is Not Forgiveness
1100507.desc: Immediately attacks all enemies within a set range. After entering combat, deals Lightning DMG equal to #3[i]% of Kafka's ATK to all enemies, with a #1[i]% base chance to inflict Shock (equivalent to that applied by her Ultimate) on every enemy target for #2[i] turn(s).
1100507.desc_cn: 立即攻击一定范围内的所有敌人，进入战斗后对敌方全体造成等同于卡芙卡#3[i]%攻击力的雷属性伤害，同时有#1[i]%的基础概率使敌方每个单体目标陷入与终结技相同的触电状态，持续#2[i]回合。

1100601.name: System Warning
1100601.desc: Deals Quantum DMG equal to #1[i]% of Silver Wolf's ATK to one designated enemy.
1100601.desc_cn: 对指定敌方单体造成等同于银狼#1[i]%攻击力的量子属性伤害。

1100602.name: Allow Changes?
1100602.desc:
There is a #2[i]% base chance to add 1 Weakness of an on-field ally target's Type to one designated enemy target (prioritizing the implant of a Weakness that matches the first character in the team lineup). This also reduces the enemy target's RES to that Weakness Type by #4[i]% for #3[i] turn(s). If the enemy target already has that Type of Weakness, the RES reduction effect to that Type will not be triggered.
Each enemy target can only have 1 Weakness implanted by Silver Wolf. When Silver Wolf implants another Weakness to the target, only the most recent implanted Weakness will be retained.
In addition, there is a #5[i]% base chance to further reduce the target's All-Type RES by #6[f1]% for #7[i] turn(s).
Deals Quantum DMG equal to #1[i]% of Silver Wolf's ATK to this target.
1100602.desc_cn:
有#2[i]%的基础概率为指定敌方单体目标添加1个场上我方目标持有属性的弱点（优先添加我方编队中的第一位角色持有属性的弱点），且该弱点对应属性的抗性降低#4[i]%，持续#3[i]回合。若添加的是敌方目标原有属性的弱点，则不会触发对应属性的抗性降低效果。
单个敌方目标仅能被银狼添加1个弱点，当银狼对其再次添加弱点时，仅保留最新添加的弱点。
有#5[i]%的基础概率额外使该目标的全属性抗性降低#6[f1]%，持续#7[i]回合。
对该目标造成等同于银狼#1[i]%攻击力的量子属性伤害。

1100603.name: User Banned
1100603.desc: Has a #2[i]% base chance to reduce the DEF of all enemies by #3[f1]% for #4[i] turn(s). At the same time, deals Quantum DMG equal to #1[i]% of Silver Wolf's ATK to all enemies.
1100603.desc_cn: 有#2[i]%的基础概率使敌方全体防御力降低#3[f1]%，持续#4[i]回合，同时对敌方全体造成等同于银狼#1[i]%攻击力的量子属性伤害。

1100604.name: Awaiting System Response...
1100604.desc:
Silver Wolf can create three types of "Bugs": Reduce ATK by #1[f1]%, reduce DEF by #2[f1]%, and reduce SPD by #3[f1]%.
After every attack launched by Silver Wolf, she has a #4[i]% base chance to implant 1 random "Bug" that lasts for #5[i] turn(s) in the attacked enemy target. 
When the enemy target gets defeated, the Weakness Silver Wolf implanted on it will be transferred to another surviving enemy on the field that hasn't been implanted with Weakness by Silver Wolf, prioritizing targets at Elite-level and above.
1100604.desc_cn:
银狼能够制造：攻击力降低#1[f1]%、防御力降低#2[f1]%、速度降低#3[f1]%3种【缺陷】。
银狼每次施放攻击后有#4[i]%的基础概率给受到攻击的敌方目标植入1个随机【缺陷】，持续#5[i]回合。
敌方目标被消灭时，银狼对其添加的弱点会转移给场上存活的未被银狼添加弱点的敌人，优先转移给精英级别及以上的目标。

1100606.name: Attack
1100606.desc: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.
1100606.desc_cn: 攻击敌人，进入战斗后削弱敌方目标对应属性韧性。

1100607.name: Force Quit Program
1100607.desc: Immediately attacks the enemy. After entering combat, deals Quantum DMG equal to #1[i]% of Silver Wolf's ATK to all enemies, and reduces Toughness of all enemies regardless of Weakness Types. Enemies with their Weakness Broken in this way will trigger the Quantum Weakness Break effect.
1100607.desc_cn: 立即攻击敌人，进入战斗后对敌方全体造成等同于银狼#1[i]%攻击力的量子属性伤害，并无视弱点属性削减敌方全体的韧性，击破弱点时，触发量子属性的弱点击破效果。

1110201.name: Thwack
1110201.desc: Deals Quantum DMG equal to #1[i]% of Seele's ATK to one designated enemy.
1110201.desc_cn: 对指定敌方单体造成等同于希儿#1[i]%攻击力的量子属性伤害。

1110202.name: Sheathed Blade
1110202.desc:
Increases Seele's SPD by #2[i]% for #3[i] turn(s) and deals Quantum DMG equal to #1[i]% of Seele's ATK to one designated enemy.
After an ally target attacks, if the attack target's current HP percentage is #4[i]% or below, Seele will automatically use her Skill at that target 1 time. This Skill does not consume Skill Points or regenerate Energy. This effect can only be triggered 1 time per turn and resets at the start of Seele's turn. If there are no valid targets to attack, she attacks the enemy target with the lowest HP percentage instead.
1110202.desc_cn:
使希儿的速度提高#2[i]%，并对指定敌方单体造成等同于希儿#1[i]%攻击力的量子属性伤害，速度提高效果持续#3[i]回合。
我方目标攻击后，被攻击目标当前生命值百分比小于等于#4[i]%，则希儿自动对其施放1次战技，此次战技不消耗战技点且不恢复能量，该效果每个回合最多触发1次，希儿回合开始时重置可触发次数。若不存在可攻击的目标，则攻击生命值最低的敌方单体目标。

1110203.name: Butterfly Flurry
1110203.desc: Seele enters the Amplification state and deals Quantum DMG equal to #1[i]% of her ATK to one designated enemy.
1110203.desc_cn: 立即进入增幅状态，并对指定敌方单体造成等同于希儿#1[i]%攻击力的量子属性伤害。

1110204.name: Resurgence
1110204.desc:
Enters the Amplification state upon defeating an enemy with Basic ATK, Skill, or Ultimate, and receives an extra turn. While in the Amplification state, increases the DMG dealt by Seele increases by #1[i]% for #2[i] turn(s).
Enemies defeated in the extra turn provided by "Resurgence" will not trigger another "Resurgence."
1110204.desc_cn:
施放普攻、战技、终结技消灭敌方目标时立即获得1个额外回合并进入增幅状态，增幅状态下希儿造成的伤害提高#1[i]%，持续#2[i]回合。
若希儿在因天赋【再现】获得的额外回合中消灭敌方目标，此天赋不会生效。

1110206.name: Attack
1110206.desc: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.
1110206.desc_cn: 攻击敌人，进入战斗后削弱敌方目标对应属性韧性。

1110207.name: Phantom Illusion
1110207.desc: After using her Technique, Seele gains Stealth for #1[i] second(s). While Stealth is active, Seele cannot be detected by enemies. And when entering combat by attacking enemies, Seele will immediately enter the Amplification state and deals Quantum DMG equal to Seele's Skill DMG multiplier to random enemy target 1 time. This DMG is a guaranteed CRIT Hit.
1110207.desc_cn: 使用秘技后进入持续#1[i]秒的隐身状态。隐身状态下不会被敌人发现，主动攻击敌人进入战斗时，希儿立即进入增幅状态且对随机敌方目标造成1次等同于希儿战技伤害倍率的量子属性伤害，该伤害必定暴击。

1120501.name: Shard Sword
1120501.desc: Deals Wind DMG equal to #1[i]% of Blade's Max HP to one designated enemy.
1120501.desc_cn: 对指定敌方单体造成等同于刃#1[i]%生命上限的风属性伤害。

1120502.name: Hellscape
1120502.desc:
Consumes HP equal to #1[i]% of Blade's Max HP to enter the "Hellscape" state.
While "Hellscape" is active, his Skill cannot be used, his DMG dealt increases by #4[i]%, his chance of getting attacked by enemy targets greatly increases, and his Basic ATK "Shard Sword" is enhanced to "Forest of Swords" for #2[i] turn(s).
If Blade's current HP is insufficient, his HP will be reduced to 1 when he uses his Skill.
This Skill does not regenerate Energy. Using this Skill does not end the current turn.
1120502.desc_cn:
消耗等同于刃生命上限#1[i]%的生命值，进入【地狱变】状态。
处于【地狱变】状态时无法施放战技，同时使自身造成的伤害提高#4[i]%，被敌方目标攻击的概率大幅提高，普攻【支离剑】强化为【无间剑树】，持续#2[i]回合。
若当前生命值不足，施放战技时刃的当前生命值降低至1点。
该战技无法恢复能量。施放该战技后，本回合不会结束。

1120503.name: Death Sentence
1120503.desc:
Sets Blade's current HP to 50% of his Max HP and deals Wind DMG to one enemy equal to #1[i]% of his Max HP plus #5[i]% of the tally of Blade's HP loss in the current battle. At the same time, deals Wind DMG to adjacent targets equal to #3[f1]% of his Max HP plus #6[i]% of the tally of his HP loss in the current battle.
The tally of Blade's HP loss in the current battle is capped at #7[i]% of his Max HP. This value will be reset and re-accumulated after his Ultimate has been used.
1120503.desc_cn:
将刃的当前生命值转化为生命上限的50%，并对敌方单体造成等同于刃#1[i]%生命上限+#5[i]%本场战斗中累计已损失生命值的风属性伤害，同时对其相邻目标造成等同于刃#3[f1]%生命上限+#6[i]%本场战斗中累计已损失生命值的风属性伤害。
本场战斗中累计已损失生命值最高不超过刃生命上限的#7[i]%，施放终结技后会清空并进行重新累计。

1120504.name: Shuhu's Gift
1120504.desc:
When Blade sustains DMG or consumes his HP, he gains 1 stack of Charge, stacking up to 5 times. A max of 1 Charge stack can be gained every time he is attacked.
When Charge stack reaches maximum, immediately launches 1 instance of Follow-Up ATK on all enemies, dealing Wind DMG equal to #2[i]% of Blade's Max HP. At the same time, restores Blade's HP by #3[i]% of his Max HP. After the Follow-Up ATK, all Charges are consumed.
1120504.desc_cn:
刃受到伤害或消耗生命值时，获得1层充能，最多叠加5层。该效果每次受到攻击最多叠加1层。
当充能叠加至上限时，立即对敌方全体施放1次追加攻击，造成等同于刃#2[i]%生命上限的风属性伤害并回复等同于刃生命上限#3[i]%的生命值，施放追加攻击后，消耗所有充能。

1120506.name: Attack
1120506.desc: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.
1120506.desc_cn: 攻击敌人，进入战斗后削弱敌方目标对应属性韧性。

1120507.name: Karma Wind
1120507.desc:
Immediately attacks the enemy. After entering combat, consumes #2[i]% of Blade's Max HP while dealing Wind DMG equal to #1[i]% of his Max HP to all enemies.
If Blade's current HP is insufficient, his HP will be reduced to 1 when this Technique is used.
1120507.desc_cn:
立即攻击敌人，进入战斗后消耗等同于刃生命上限#2[i]%的生命值，同时对敌方全体造成等同于刃生命上限#1[i]%的风属性伤害。
若当前生命值不足，施放秘技时刃的当前生命值降低至1点。

1120508.name: Forest of Swords
1120508.desc:
Consumes HP equal to #1[i]% of Blade's Max HP and deals Wind DMG equal to #2[i]% of his Max HP to one designated enemy. In addition, deals Wind DMG equal to #3[i]% of Blade's Max HP to adjacent targets.
If Blade's current HP is insufficient, his HP will be reduced to 1 when using "Forest of Swords."
"Forest of Swords" cannot regenerate Skill Points.
1120508.desc_cn:
消耗等同于刃生命上限#1[i]%的生命值，对指定敌方单体造成等同于刃#2[i]%生命上限的风属性伤害，同时对其相邻目标造成等同于刃#3[i]%生命上限的风属性伤害。
若当前生命值不足，施放【无间剑树】时刃的当前生命值降低至1点。
【无间剑树】无法恢复战技点。

1121201.name: Lucent Moonglow
1121201.desc: Deals Ice DMG equal to #1[i]% of Jingliu's Max HP to one designated enemy.
1121201.desc_cn: 对指定敌方单体造成等同于镜流#1[i]%生命上限的冰属性伤害。

1121202.name: Transcendent Flash
1121202.desc: Deals Ice DMG equal to #1[i]% of Jingliu's Max HP to one designated enemy and gains #2[i] stack(s) of "Syzygy."
1121202.desc_cn: 对指定敌方单体造成等同于镜流#1[i]%生命上限的冰属性伤害，并获得#2[i]层【朔望】。

1121203.name: Florephemeral Dreamflux
1121203.desc: Deals Ice DMG equal to #1[i]% of Jingliu's Max HP to one designated enemy, and deals Ice DMG equal to #3[i]% of Jingliu's Max HP to adjacent targets. Gains #2[i] stack(s) of "Syzygy" after the attack ends.
1121203.desc_cn: 对指定敌方单体造成等同于镜流#1[i]%生命上限的冰属性伤害，并对其相邻目标造成等同于镜流#3[i]%生命上限的冰属性伤害。攻击结束后获得#2[i]层【朔望】。

1121204.name: Crescent Transmigration
1121204.desc: When Jingliu has #5[i] stacks of "Syzygy," she enters the "Spectral Transmigration" state with 1 extra stack of "Syzygy" gained, her action advanced by #6[i]%, and her CRIT Rate increased by #7[i]%. Then, Jingliu's Skill "Transcendent Flash" is enhanced to "Moon On Glacial River," and only this enhanced Skill is available for use in battle. When Jingliu uses an attack in the Spectral Transmigration state, she consumes HP from her teammates equal to #2[i]% of their respective Max HP (this cannot reduce teammates' HP to lower than 1). During the "Spectral Transmigration" state, when ally targets receive DMG or consume HP, Jingliu gains 1 stack of "Moonlight." Each "Moonlight" stack increases Jingliu's CRIT DMG by #3[i]%, stacking up to #4[i] time(s). Jingliu cannot enter the "Spectral Transmigration" state again until the current "Spectral Transmigration" state ends. "Syzygy" can stack up to 4 times. When "Syzygy" stacks become 0, Jingliu will exit the "Spectral Transmigration" state and remove all "Moonlight." After ally targets receive DMG or consume HP for a total of #8[i] times, Jingliu gains 1 stack of "Syzygy." Each attack received by each target is only counted once.
1121204.desc_cn: 当拥有#5[i]层【朔望】时，镜流将进入【转魄】状态，额外获得1层【朔望】并使行动提前#6[i]%、暴击率提高#7[i]%，随后战技【无罅飞光】强化为【寒川映月】且仅能使用该战技。【转魄】状态下施放攻击时，消耗队友#2[i]%生命上限的生命值（最多消耗到每位队友生命值等于1）。【转魄】状态内，我方目标受到伤害或消耗生命值时，镜流会获得1层【月色】，每层【月色】使镜流造成的暴击伤害提高#3[i]%，最多拥有#4[i]层。【转魄】状态结束前无法再次进入【转魄】状态。【朔望】最多可累计4层，当【朔望】层数为0时，退出【转魄】状态并移除所有的【月色】。我方目标累计受到伤害或消耗生命值#8[i]次后，镜流获得1层【朔望】，每个目标每次受到攻击最多计算1次。

1121206.name: Attack
1121206.desc: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.
1121206.desc_cn: 攻击敌人，进入战斗后削弱敌方目标对应属性韧性。

1121207.name: Shine of Truth
1121207.desc: After using Technique, creates a Special Dimension around this unit that lasts for #3[i] seconds. All enemies in this Special Dimension will become Frozen. After entering combat with enemies in the Special Dimension, Jingliu immediately regenerates #6[i] Energy and obtains #1[i] stack(s) of "Syzygy," with a #2[i]% base chance of Freezing enemy targets for #4[i] turn(s). While Frozen, enemy targets cannot take action, and take Ice Additional DMG equal to #5[i]% of Jingliu's Max HP at the start of every turn. Only 1 Dimension Effect created by allies can exist at the same time.
1121207.desc_cn: 使用秘技后，在自身周围制造1片持续#3[i]秒的特殊领域，处于特殊领域内的敌人陷入冻结状态。与处于特殊领域内的敌人进入战斗后，立即为自身恢复#6[i]点能量、获得#1[i]层【朔望】并有#2[i]%的基础概率使敌方目标陷入冻结状态，持续#4[i]回合。冻结状态下，敌方目标无法行动，且每回合开始时受到等同于镜流#5[i]%生命上限的冰属性附加伤害。我方制造的领域效果最多存在1个。

1121209.name: Moon On Glacial River
1121209.desc: Deals Ice DMG equal to #1[i]% of Jingliu's Max HP to one designated enemy, and deals Ice DMG equal to #3[i]% of Jingliu's Max HP to adjacent targets. Consumes #2[i] stack(s) of "Syzygy." Using this ability does not consume Skill Points.
1121209.desc_cn: 对指定敌方单体造成等同于镜流#1[i]%生命上限的冰属性伤害，并对其相邻目标造成等同于镜流#3[i]%生命上限的冰属性伤害。消耗#2[i]层【朔望】。施放本技能不消耗战技点。

1121701.name: Banner: Stormcaller
1121701.desc: Deals Wind DMG equal to #1[i]% of Huohuo's Max HP to one designated enemy.
1121701.desc_cn: 对指定敌方单体造成等同于藿藿#1[i]%生命上限的风属性伤害。

1121702.name: Talisman: Protection
1121702.desc: Dispels #5[i] debuff(s) from one designated ally and immediately restores this ally's HP by an amount equal to #1[f1]% of Huohuo's Max HP plus #2[i]. At the same time, restores HP for allies that are adjacent to this target ally by an amount equal to #3[f1]% of Huohuo's Max HP plus #4[i].
1121702.desc_cn: 解除指定我方单体的#5[i]个负面效果，立即为指定我方单体回复等同于藿藿#1[f1]%生命上限+#2[i]的生命值，同时为其相邻目标回复等同于藿藿#3[f1]%生命上限+#4[i]的生命值。

1121703.name: Tail: Spiritual Domination
1121703.desc: Regenerates Energy for all teammates (i.e., excluding this unit) by an amount equal to #1[f1]% of their respective Max Energy. At the same time, increases their ATK by #2[f1]% for #3[i] turn(s).
1121703.desc_cn: 为除自身以外的队友恢复等同于各自#1[f1]%能量上限的能量，同时使其攻击力提高#2[f1]%，持续#3[i]回合。

1121704.name: Possession: Ethereal Metaflow
1121704.desc:
After using her Skill or Ultimate, Huohuo gains "Divine Provision," lasting for #1[i] turn(s). This duration decreases by 1 turn at the start of Huohuo's every turn. When Huohuo has "Divine Provision" at the start of an ally target's turn or when they use their Ultimate, restores HP for that ally target and the ally target with the lowest HP percentage by an amount equal to #3[f1]% of Huohuo's Max HP plus #5[i]. Then, restores HP for every ally with a current HP percentage at or below #6[i]% by an amount equal to #3[f1]% of Huohuo's Max HP plus #5[i].
When "Divine Provision" is triggered to heal an ally target, dispels #2[i] debuff(s) from that target. This effect can be triggered #7[i] time(s). Gaining "Divine Provision" again resets the effect's trigger count.
1121704.desc_cn:
施放战技或终结技后藿藿获得【禳命】，持续#1[i]回合，藿藿每回合开始时持续回合数减1。当藿藿拥有【禳命】时，我方目标回合开始或施放终结技时回复自身和生命值百分比最低的我方目标等同于藿藿#3[f1]%生命上限+#5[i]的生命值，随后使每个当前生命值百分比小于等于#6[i]%的我方目标回复等同于藿藿#3[f1]%生命上限+#5[i]的生命值。
触发【禳命】为我方目标提供治疗时，解除该目标#2[i]个负面效果，该效果可以触发#7[i]次，再次获得【禳命】后将刷新效果可触发次数。

1121706.name: Attack
1121706.desc: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.
1121706.desc_cn: 攻击敌人，进入战斗后削弱敌方目标对应属性韧性。

1121707.name: Fiend: Impeachment of Evil
1121707.desc: Huohuo terrorizes surrounding enemies, inflicting "Horror-Struck" on them. Enemies in "Horror-Struck" will flee away from Huohuo for #4[i] second(s). When entering combat with enemies in "Horror-Struck," there is a #1[i]% base chance of reducing every single enemy's ATK by #2[i]% for #3[i] turn(s).
1121707.desc_cn: 藿藿恐吓周围的敌人，使其陷入【魄散】状态。【魄散】状态下的敌人会向远离藿藿的方向逃跑，持续#4[i]秒。与陷入【魄散】状态的敌人进入战斗后，有#1[i]%的基础概率使敌方每个单体目标攻击力降低#2[i]%，持续#3[i]回合。

1130601.name: Monodrama
1130601.desc: Deals Quantum DMG equal to #1[i]% of Sparkle's ATK to one designated enemy.
1130601.desc_cn: 对指定敌方单体造成等同于花火#1[i]%攻击力的量子属性伤害。

1130602.name: Dreamdiver
1130602.desc:
Increases the CRIT DMG of a designated ally by #1[f1]% of Sparkle's CRIT DMG plus #2[f1]%, lasting for #3[i] turn(s). And at the same time, advances this ally's action by #4[i]%.
When Sparkle uses this ability on herself, the Action Advance effect will not trigger.
1130602.desc_cn:
使指定我方单体的暴击伤害提高，提高数值等同于花火#1[f1]%暴击伤害+#2[f1]%，持续#3[i]回合，并使该目标行动提前#4[i]%。
当花火对自身施放该技能时，无法触发行动提前效果。

1130603.name: The Hero with a Thousand Faces
1130603.desc: Recovers #2[i] Skill Point(s) for allies. If Skill Points overflow during recovery, the excess points will be recorded, up to a max of #5[i] points. When an ally character's turn ends, if Skill Points are below the maximum, Sparkle consumes the recorded value to recover Skill Points until the upper limit is reached. Then, grants all allies "Cipher." For ally targets with "Cipher," each stack of Boost of DMG taken by enemies provided by Sparkle's Talent additionally increases by #3[f2]%, lasting for #4[i] turn(s).
1130603.desc_cn: 为我方恢复#2[i]个战技点，若恢复时战技点溢出，则记录溢出的战技点数，最多记录#5[i]点。我方角色回合结束后若战技点小于上限，花火消耗记录值为我方恢复战技点，直至恢复至上限。随后使我方全体获得【谜诡】。持有【谜诡】的我方目标触发花火天赋造成的敌方受到伤害提高效果每层额外提高#3[f2]%，持续#4[i]回合。

1130604.name: Red Herring
1130604.desc: While Sparkle is on the battlefield, additionally increases the max number of Skill Points by #3[i]. Whenever an ally target consumes 1 Skill Point, Sparkle gains 1 stack of "Figment," with each stack increasing the DMG taken by all enemies by #2[f1]%. This effect lasts for #1[i] turn(s) and can stack up to #4[i] time(s).
1130604.desc_cn: 花火在场时，战技点上限额外增加#3[i]点。当我方目标每消耗1点战技点，花火获得1层【幻相】，每层【幻相】使敌方全体受到的伤害提高#2[f1]%，该效果持续#1[i]回合，最多可叠加#4[i]层。

1130606.name: Attack
1130606.desc: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.
1130606.desc_cn: 攻击敌人，进入战斗后削弱敌方目标对应属性韧性。

1130607.name: Unreliable Narrator
1130607.desc: After using Technique, grants all allies Misdirect for #2[i] seconds. Characters with Misdirect will not be detected by enemies, and entering combat in the Misdirect state recovers #1[i] Skill Point(s) for the team and regenerates #2[i] Energy for Sparkle.
1130607.desc_cn: 使用秘技后，我方全体进入持续#2[i]秒的【迷误】状态。【迷误】状态下不会被敌人发现。【迷误】状态期间进入战斗时为我方恢复#1[i]个战技点，并使花火恢复#2[i]点能量。

1130701.name: Percipience, Silent Dawn
1130701.desc: Deals Wind DMG equal to #1[i]% of Black Swan's ATK to one designated enemy.
1130701.desc_cn: 对指定敌方单体造成等同于黑天鹅#1[i]%攻击力的风属性伤害。

1130702.name: Decadence, False Twilight
1130702.desc: Deals Wind DMG equal to #1[i]% of Black Swan's ATK to one designated enemy and adjacent targets. At the same time, there is a #3[i]% base chance of reducing the DEF of the enemy target and the adjacent targets by #4[f1]%, lasting for #2[i] turn(s).
1130702.desc_cn: 对指定敌方单体及其相邻目标造成等同于黑天鹅#1[i]%攻击力的风属性伤害，同时有#3[i]%的基础概率使目标与相邻目标防御力降低#4[f1]%，持续#2[i]回合。

1130703.name: Bliss of Otherworld's Embrace
1130703.desc:
Inflicts "Epiphany" state on all enemies for #2[i] turn(s). Then deals Wind DMG to all enemies equal to #1[i]% of Black Swan's ATK.
While in the "Epiphany" state, enemy targets take #3[i]% increased DMG. For every 1 stack of "Arcana inflicted," there is a #4[i]% fixed chance to additionally increase the number of "Arcana" stacked this time by 1. And "Arcana" stacks won't be halved after dealing DMG at the start of the turn.
1130703.desc_cn:
使敌方全体陷入【揭露】状态，持续#2[i]回合。随后对敌方全体造成等同于黑天鹅#1[i]%攻击力的风属性伤害。
【揭露】状态下，敌方目标受到的伤害提高#3[i]%。每陷入1层【奥迹】时，有#4[i]%的固定概率使本次叠加层数额外提高1层，并且【奥迹】回合开始造成伤害后层数不会减半。

1130704.name: Loom of Fate's Caprice
1130704.desc:
Every time an enemy target receives 1 instance of DoT, there is a #2[i]% base chance for it to be inflicted with 1 stack of "Arcana".
While an enemy target is in the "Arcana" state, they are also considered to be simultaneously afflicted with Wind Shear, Bleed, Burn, and Shock. The target receives Wind DoT equal to #1[i]% of Black Swan's ATK at the start of each turn, after which the number of stacks is halved. Each stack of "Arcana" increases this DMG multiplier by #3[f1]%. "Arcana" can stack #8[i] times, and can continue to stack beyond this limit, with the excess stacks removed after dealing DMG.
DMG from "Arcana" ignores #7[i]% of the target's DEF. Only when "Arcana" deals DMG at the start of the enemy target's turn, adjacent targets take 1 additional instance of Wind DoT equal to #5[i]% of Black Swan's ATK.
1130704.desc_cn:
敌方目标每受到1次持续伤害，有#2[i]%的基础概率陷入1层【奥迹】。
敌方目标处于【奥迹】状态时，也会被视为同时陷入了风化、裂伤、灼烧、触电状态，每回合开始时受到等同于黑天鹅#1[i]%攻击力的风属性持续伤害，随后层数减半。每层【奥迹】使此伤害倍率提高#3[f1]%。【奥迹】可以叠加#8[i]层，层数达到上限后可继续叠加，产生伤害后移除超出上限的层数。
【奥迹】造成的伤害无视目标#7[i]%的防御力。仅在敌方目标回合开始【奥迹】造成伤害时，相邻目标额外受到1次等同于黑天鹅#5[i]%攻击力的风属性持续伤害。

1130706.name: Attack
1130706.desc: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.
1130706.desc_cn: 攻击敌人，进入战斗后削弱敌方目标对应属性韧性。

1130707.name: From Façade to Vérité
1130707.desc: After Technique is used, there is a #1[i]% base chance for each enemy to be inflicted with 1 stack of "Arcana" at the start of the next battle. For each successful application of "Arcana" on a target, inflicts another stack of "Arcana" on the same target. This process repeats until "Arcana" fails to be inflicted on this target. For each successive application of "Arcana" on a target, its base chance of success is equal to #2[i]% of the base chance of the previous successful infliction of "Arcana" on that target.
1130707.desc_cn: 使用秘技后，下一次战斗开始时有#1[i]%的基础概率使敌方每个单体目标陷入1层【奥迹】。使其中每个成功陷入【奥迹】的目标再次陷入1层【奥迹】，重复此效果直到未能成功使该目标陷入【奥迹】。每次使目标陷入【奥迹】的基础概率等同于上一次成功使该目标陷入【奥迹】时的基础概率的#2[i]%。

1131001.name: Order: Flare Propulsion
1131001.desc: Deals Fire DMG equal to #1[i]% of SAM's ATK to one designated enemy.
1131001.desc_cn: 对指定敌方单体造成等同于装甲「萨姆」#1[i]%攻击力的火属性伤害。

1131002.name: Order: Aerial Bombardment
1131002.desc: Consumes HP equal to #2[i]% of this unit's Max HP and regenerates a fixed amount of Energy equal to #3[i]% of this unit's Max Energy. Deals Fire DMG equal to #1[i]% of SAM's ATK to one designated enemy. If the current HP is not sufficient, reduces SAM's HP to 1 when using this Skill. Advances this unit's next Action by #4[i]%.
1131002.desc_cn: 消耗等同于自身生命上限#2[i]%的生命值固定恢复等同于自身#3[i]%能量上限的能量，对指定敌方单体造成等同于装甲「萨姆」#1[i]%攻击力的火属性伤害。若当前生命值不足，施放战技时装甲「萨姆」的当前生命值降至1点。使自身下一次行动提前#4[i]%。

1131003.name: Fyrefly Type-IV: Complete Combustion
1131003.desc:
Enters the Complete Combustion state, advances this unit's Action by 100%, and gains Enhanced Basic ATK and Enhanced Skill. While in Complete Combustion, increases SPD by #3[i], and when using the Enhanced Basic ATK or Enhanced Skill, increases this unit's Weakness Break Efficiency by #2[i]% and increases the Break DMG dealt by SAM to the enemy targets by #1[f1]%, lasting until this current attack ends.
A countdown timer for the Complete Combustion state appears in the Action Order. When the countdown timer's turn starts, SAM exits the Complete Combustion state. The countdown timer has a fixed SPD of #4[i].
SAM cannot use Ultimate while in Complete Combustion.
1131003.desc_cn:
进入「完全燃烧」状态，自身行动提前100%并获得强化普攻和强化战技。「完全燃烧」状态下速度提高#3[i]点，且施放强化普攻、强化战技时自身弱点击破效率提高#2[i]%、使敌方目标受到装甲「萨姆」造成的击破伤害提高#1[f1]%，持续至本次攻击结束。
行动序列上出现「完全燃烧」倒计时，倒计时回合开始时装甲「萨姆」解除「完全燃烧」状态，倒计时固定拥有#4[i]速度。
「完全燃烧」状态下装甲「萨姆」无法施放终结技。

1131004.name: Chrysalid Pyronexus
1131004.desc:
The lower the HP, the less DMG received. When HP is #3[i]% or lower, the DMG Reduction reaches its maximum effect, reducing up to #1[i]%. During the Complete Combustion, the DMG Reduction remains at its maximum effect, and the Effect RES increases by #4[i]%.
If Energy is lower than #2[i]% when the battle starts, regenerates Energy to #2[i]%. Once Energy is regenerated to its maximum, dispels all debuffs on this unit.
1131004.desc_cn:
生命值越低受到的伤害越低，生命值小于等于#3[i]%时减伤效果达到最大值，最多降低#1[i]%。「完全燃烧」状态下减伤效果维持最大值，效果抵抗提高#4[i]%。
战斗开始时若能量不足#2[i]%则使其恢复至#2[i]%。当能量恢复至上限时解除自身所有负面效果。

1131006.name: Attack
1131006.desc: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.
1131006.desc_cn: 攻击敌人，进入战斗后削弱敌方目标对应属性韧性。

1131007.name: Δ Order: Meteoric Incineration
1131007.desc: Leaps into the air and moves about freely for #1[i] seconds, which can be ended early by launching a plunging attack. When the duration ends, plunges and immediately attacks all enemies within a set area. At the start of each wave, applies a Fire Weakness to all enemies, lasting for #3[i] turn(s). Then, deals Fire DMG equal to #2[i]% of SAM's ATK to all enemies.
1131007.desc_cn: 跳跃至空中并进行自由移动，持续#1[i]秒，此时施放下落攻击可以提前结束持续时间。持续时间结束后，下落并立即攻击一定范围内的所有敌人，每个波次开始时为敌方全体添加火属性弱点，持续#3[i]回合，此后对敌方全体造成等同于装甲「萨姆」#2[i]%攻击力的火属性伤害。

1131008.name: Fyrefly Type-IV: Pyrogenic Decimation
1131008.desc: Restores HP by an amount equal to #2[i]% of this unit's Max HP. Deals Fire DMG equal to #1[i]% of SAM's ATK to one designated enemy.
1131008.desc_cn: 回复等同于自身#2[i]%生命上限的生命值。对指定敌方单体造成等同于装甲「萨姆」#1[i]%攻击力的火属性伤害。

1131009.name: Fyrefly Type-IV: Deathstar Overload
1131009.desc: Restores HP by an amount equal to 25% of this unit's Max HP. Adds Fire Weakness to one designated enemy and its adjacent targets, lasting for 2 turns. Deals Fire DMG equal to (#5[f1] × Break Effect + #1[f1]%) of SAM's ATK to this target. At the same time, deals Fire DMG equal to (#6[f1] × Break Effect + #2[f1]%) of SAM's ATK to adjacent targets. The Break Effect taken into the calculation is capped at #7[i]%.
1131009.desc_cn: 回复等同于自身25%生命上限的生命值。为指定敌方单体及其相邻目标添加火属性弱点，持续2回合。对该目标造成等同于装甲「萨姆」（#5[f1]*击破特攻+#1[f1]%）攻击力的火属性伤害。同时对其相邻目标造成等同于装甲「萨姆」（#6[f1]*击破特攻+#2[f1]%）攻击力的火属性伤害。最多计算#7[i]%击破特攻。

1140201.name: Thorned Snare
1140201.desc: Deals Lightning DMG equal to #1[i]% of ATK to one enemy and Lightning DMG equal to #2[i]% of ATK to adjacent targets.
1140201.desc_cn: 对敌方单体造成#1[i]%攻击力的雷属性伤害，对其相邻目标造成#2[i]%攻击力的雷属性伤害。

1140203.name: A Body Brewed by Tears
1140203.desc: After attacking an enemy afflicted with "Seam Stitch," increases this unit's SPD by #1[i], stacking up to #3[i] time(s). When Garmentmaker takes action, automatically uses "Thorned Snare," prioritizing enemies under the "Seam Stitch" state.
1140203.desc_cn: 攻击处于【间隙织线】状态的敌人后，使自身的速度提高#1[i]点，该效果最多叠加#3[i]层。衣匠行动时自动施放【刺纹之陷】，优先攻击处于【间隙织线】状态下的敌人。

1140205.name: The Speeding Summer
1140205.desc: When Garmentmaker is summoned, this unit's action advances by #1[i]%.
1140205.desc_cn: 衣匠被召唤时，使自身行动提前#1[i]%。

1140206.name: Bloom of Drying Grass
1140206.desc: When Garmentmaker disappears, regenerates #1[i] Energy for Aglaea.
1140206.desc_cn: 衣匠消失时，使阿格莱雅恢复#1[i]点能量。

1140701.name: Claw Splits the Veil
1140701.desc: Deals Quantum DMG equal to #1[f1]% of Castorice's Max HP to all enemies.
1140701.desc_cn: 对敌方全体造成等同于遐蝶#1[f1]%生命上限的量子属性伤害。

1140702.name: Breath Scorches the Shadow
1140702.desc:
Launching "Breath Scorches the Shadow" will consume #1[i]% of Netherwing's Max HP to deal Quantum DMG equal to #2[f1]% of Castorice's Max HP to all enemies.
In one attack, "Breath Scorches the Shadow" can be launched repeatedly, with the DMG multiplier increased progressively to #3[f1]% / #4[f1]%. After reaching #4[f1]%, it will not increase further. The DMG Multiplier Boost effect will not decrease before Netherwing disappears.
When Netherwing's current HP is equal to or less than #5[i]% of its Max HP, launching this ability will actively reduce HP down to 1, and then trigger the ability effect equal to that of the Talent "Wings Sweep the Ruins."
1140702.desc_cn:
发动【燎尽黯泽的焰息】会消耗等同于死龙生命上限#1[i]%的生命值，对敌方全体造成等同于遐蝶#2[f1]%生命上限的量子属性伤害。
一次攻击中可重复发动【燎尽黯泽的焰息】，重复发动时，伤害倍率依次提高至#3[f1]%/#4[f1]%，达到#4[f1]%后不再提高，伤害倍率提高效果在死龙消失前不会降低。
死龙当前生命值小于等于自身生命上限#5[i]%时，发动该技能会主动将生命值降至1点后触发等同于天赋【灼掠幽墟的晦翼】的技能效果。

1140703.name: Mooncocoon Shrouds the Form
1140703.desc: When Netherwing is on the field, it acts as backup for allies. When allies take DMG or consume HP, their current HP can be reduced down to a minimum of 1, after which Netherwing will bear the HP loss. But Netherwing consumes HP equal to #1[i]% of the original value. This lasts until Netherwing disappears.
1140703.desc_cn: 死龙在场时为我方后援，我方受到伤害或消耗生命值时，当前生命值最多降至1点，此后由死龙承担，但死龙会消耗等同于原数值#1[i]%的生命值，持续至死龙消失。

1140705.name: Roar Rumbles the Realm
1140705.desc: When Netherwing is summoned, increases DMG dealt by all allies by #1[i]%, lasting for #2[i] turn(s).
1140705.desc_cn: 死龙被召唤时，我方全体造成的伤害提高#1[i]%，持续#2[i]回合。

1140706.name: Wings Sweep the Ruins
1140706.desc: When Netherwing disappears, deals #2[i] instance(s) of DMG, with each instance dealing Quantum DMG equal to #1[f1]% of Castorice's Max HP to one random enemy. At the same time, restores HP by an amount equal to #3[i]% of Castorice's Max HP plus #4[i] for all allies.
1140706.desc_cn: 死龙消失时，造成#2[i]次伤害，每次伤害对敌方随机单体造成等同于遐蝶#1[f1]%生命上限的量子属性伤害，同时为我方全体回复等同于遐蝶#3[i]%生命上限+#4[i]点的生命值。

1140710.name: Breath Scorches the Shadow
1140710.desc: Consumes this unit's HP to deal Quantum DMG to all enemies, and this turn will not conclude. When using this ability repeatedly, the ability can be enhanced up to 3 times. When HP is #5[i]% or lower, using this ability will actively trigger the ability effect of Memosprite Talent "Wings Sweep the Ruins."
1140710.desc_cn: 消耗自身生命值，对敌方全体造成量子属性伤害，且本回合不会结束。重复施放技能时，技能最多获得3次强化。生命值小于等于#5[i]%时，施放该技能会主动触发忆灵天赋【灼掠幽墟的晦翼】的技能效果。

1140711.name: Breath Scorches the Shadow
1140711.desc: Consumes this unit's HP to deal Quantum DMG to all enemies, and this turn will not conclude. When using this ability repeatedly, the ability can be enhanced up to 3 times. When HP is #5[i]% or lower, using this ability will actively trigger the ability effect of Memosprite Talent "Wings Sweep the Ruins."
1140711.desc_cn: 消耗自身生命值，对敌方全体造成量子属性伤害，且本回合不会结束。重复施放技能时，技能最多获得3次强化。生命值小于等于#5[i]%时，施放该技能会主动触发忆灵天赋【灼掠幽墟的晦翼】的技能效果。

1140712.name: Wings Sweep the Ruins
1140712.desc: Consumes all HP and deals #2[i] instance(s) of DMG, with each instance dealing Quantum DMG equal to #1[f1]% of Castorice's Max HP to one random enemy. At the same time, restores HP by an amount equal to #3[i]% of Castorice's Max HP plus #4[i] for all allies.
1140712.desc_cn: 消耗全部生命，造成#2[i]次伤害，每次伤害对敌方随机单体造成等同于遐蝶#1[f1]%生命上限的量子属性伤害，同时为我方全体回复等同于遐蝶#3[i]%生命上限+#4[i]点的生命值。

1140901.name: Rainclouds, Time to Go!
1140901.desc: Deals Wind DMG to all enemies by an amount equal to #1[i]% of the tally of healing done by Hyacine and Little Ica in the current battle, and clears #2[i]% of this tally of healing.
1140901.desc_cn: 对敌方全体造成等同于本场战斗风堇与小伊卡累计治疗数值#1[i]%的风属性伤害并清空累计治疗数值的#2[i]%。

1140903.name: Take Sky in Hand
1140903.desc:
Little Ica maintains 0 SPD, is immune to debuffs, and will not appear in the Action Order.
If the HP of an ally target (except Little Ica) is reduced, then at the start of any target's turn or after any target takes action, Little Ica will consume #1[i]% of their own Max HP and heal the ally target with reduced HP for an amount equal to #2[f1]% of Hyacine's Max HP plus #3[i].
While Hyacine is in the "After Rain" state, Little Ica gains 1 extra turn and automatically casts "Rainclouds, Time to Go!" immediately after Hyacine uses an ability. Moreover, when Little Ica triggers the Talent's healing effect, additionally restores HP for all ally targets by an amount equal to #4[f1]% of Hyacine's Max HP plus #5[i]. After Little Ica uses an ability, the duration of all their Continuous Effects decreases by 1 turn.
1140903.desc_cn:
小伊卡的速度保持为0，免疫负面效果，并且不会出现在行动序列上。
若除小伊卡外的我方目标生命值降低，小伊卡会在任意目标回合开始时或行动后，消耗自身#1[i]%生命上限的生命值，并为我方生命值降低的目标回复等同于风堇#2[f1]%生命上限+#3[i]的生命值。
风堇处于【雨过天晴】状态时，小伊卡会在风堇施放技能后立即获得1个额外回合并自动施放【乌云乌云快走开！】，并且小伊卡触发天赋的治疗效果时，额外为我方全体目标回复等同于风堇#4[f1]%生命上限+#5[i]的生命值，小伊卡施放技能后使自身所有持续效果持续回合数减1。

1140905.name: Soar, Unto the Sunlight
1140905.desc: When summoned, regenerates #1[i] Energy for Hyacine. On the first summon, additionally regenerates #2[i] Energy.
1140905.desc_cn: 被召唤时，为风堇恢复#1[i]点能量，首次被召唤时，额外恢复#2[i]点能量。

1140906.name: Fall, Then Take Wing
1140906.desc: Upon disappearing, advances the action of Hyacine by #1[i]%.
1140906.desc_cn: 消失时，使风堇行动提前#1[i]%。

1141301.name: Remembrance, Whirling, Like Rain
1141301.desc: This ability automatically selects a target, prioritizing the enemy target that Evernight last attacked. Deals Ice DMG equal to #1[i]% of Evey's Max HP to one enemy. For every #3[i] point(s) of "Memoria" Evernight currently has, additionally deals Ice DMG equal to #2[f1]% of Evey's Max HP. Gains #4[i] point(s) of "Memoria" after use.
1141301.desc_cn: 该技能自动选择目标施放，优先攻击长夜月上次攻击的敌方目标。对敌方单体造成等同于「长夜」#1[i]%生命上限的冰属性伤害，长夜月当前每有#3[i]点【忆质】，则额外造成等同于「长夜」#2[f1]%生命上限的冰属性伤害。施放后获得#4[i]点【忆质】。

1141303.name: Solitude, Drifting, In Murk
1141303.desc: Evey is immune to Crowd Control debuffs and has an increased chance of getting attacked. While Evey is on the field, Evernight and Evey deal #1[i]% increased DMG.
1141303.desc_cn: 「长夜」免疫控制类负面状态，被攻击的概率提高。「长夜」在场时，长夜月和「长夜」造成的伤害提高#1[i]%。

1141305.name: Night, Trailing, In Step
1141305.desc: When summoned, this unit immediately takes action.
1141305.desc_cn: 被召唤时，使自身立即行动。

1141306.name: You, Parting, Beyond Reach
1141306.desc: Upon disappearing, increases Evernight's SPD by #1[i]%. If the disappearance is due to using "Dream, Dissolving, as Dew," then, for every 1 "Memoria" point consumed by the attack, additionally increases Evernight's SPD by #2[i]%. Up to #3[i] "Memoria" points can be taken into account for this. The SPD Boost effect cannot stack and is removed at the start of Evernight's next turn.
1141306.desc_cn: 消失时，使长夜月的速度提高#1[i]%，若因施放【迷梦，流失，如露】消失，本次攻击每消耗了1点【忆质】额外使长夜月的速度提高#2[i]%，最多计算#3[i]点【忆质】。加速效果无法叠加，长夜月下个回合开始时移除。

1141307.name: Dream, Dissolving, as Dew
1141307.desc: This ability is used when Evernight's "Memoria" is greater than or equal to #3[i] and she is not affected by Crowd Control. For every 1 "Memoria" point currently held, deals Ice DMG equal to #1[f1]% of Evey's Max HP to the primary target, and Ice DMG equal to #2[f1]% of Evey's Max HP to the other enemy targets. After use, consumes all "Memoria" and HP, and makes Evey disappear.

1141501.name: Minuet of Blooms and Plumes
1141501.desc: Deals Ice DMG to all enemies equal to #1[i]% of Demiurge's Max HP.
1141501.desc_cn: 对敌方全体造成等同于德谬歌#1[i]%生命上限的冰属性伤害。

1141502.name: This Ode, to All Lives
1141502.desc: Applies a buff to one designated ally character. When the character is a Chrysos Heir, the target gains a special effect. When the character is not a Chrysos Heir, increases the target's DMG dealt by #2[i]% for #3[i] turns. This effect also applies on memosprites.
1141502.desc_cn: 对指定我方单体角色施加增益效果。当该角色为黄金裔时，使其获得特殊效果。当该角色不是黄金裔时，使其造成的伤害提高#2[i]%，持续#3[i]回合，该效果对其忆灵也生效。

1141503.name: Waiting, In Every Past
1141503.desc: Demiurge's SPD remains at 0, and it will not appear on the Action Order. While on the field, it is considered as Out-of-Bounds. When Cyrene's HP percentage changes, Demiurge's HP percentage will also change accordingly. While Demiurge is on the field, Cyrene's and Demiurge's Max HP increases by #1[i]%. After Demiurge uses abilities, decreases the duration of all Continuous Effects on this unit by 1.
1141503.desc_cn: 德谬歌的速度保持为0，并且不会出现在行动序列上，在场时为界外。昔涟的生命值百分比变化时，德谬歌的生命值百分比也会相应变化。德谬歌在场时，昔涟与德谬歌的生命上限提高#1[i]%。德谬歌施放技能后使自身所有持续效果持续回合数减1。

1141505.name: "Hello, World ♪"
1141505.desc: When Demiurge is summoned, dispels Crowd Control debuffs from all allies.
1141505.desc_cn: 德谬歌被召唤时，解除我方全体控制类负面状态。

1141513.name: Ode to Genesis
1141513.desc: Effective for the entire battle. When used on Trailblazer (Remembrance), increases Trailblazer (Remembrance)'s ATK by an amount equal to #1[i]% of Demiurge's Max HP, and increases Trailblazer (Remembrance)'s CRIT Rate by an amount equal to #2[i]% of Demiurge's CRIT Rate. This effect also applies to Mem. After Trailblazer (Remembrance) uses Enhanced Basic ATK in this battle, Demiurge immediately gains 1 extra turn and automatically uses "Minuet of Blooms and Plumes." If the target was defeated before this ability is used, it will be used on newly appeared enemy targets instead.
1141513.desc_cn: 整场生效，对开拓者•记忆施放时，使开拓者•记忆的攻击力提高，提高数值等同于德谬歌生命上限的#1[i]%，同时使开拓者•记忆的暴击率提高，提高数值等同于德谬歌暴击率的#2[i]%。该效果对迷迷也生效。本场战斗中，开拓者•记忆施放强化普攻后，德谬歌立即获得1个额外回合并自动施放【花与箭的舞曲】，若施放前目标被消灭则对新入场的敌方目标施放。

1141514.name: Ode to Romance
1141514.desc: One-time effect. When used on Aglaea, causes Aglaea to gain "Romance" and immediately stacks Garmentmaker's Memosprite Talent's SPD Boost effect to its upper limit. After Aglaea or Garmentmaker uses an attack, consumes "Romance" and regenerates #1[i] Energy. Increases DMG dealt by Aglaea and Garmentmaker by #2[i]%, and ignores #3[i]% of the targets' DEF, lasting until Aglaea exits the "Supreme Stance" state.
1141514.desc_cn: 单次生效，对阿格莱雅施放时，使阿格莱雅获得【浪漫】并使衣匠忆灵天赋的速度提高效果层数立即叠加至上限。阿格莱雅或衣匠攻击后，消耗【浪漫】为自身恢复#1[i]点能量。阿格莱雅与衣匠造成的伤害提高#2[i]%并无视目标#3[i]%的防御，持续至阿格莱雅退出【至高之姿】状态。

1141515.name: Ode to Passage
1141515.desc: Effective for the entire battle. When used on Tribbie, causes DMG dealt by Tribbie to ignore #2[i]% of enemies' DEF. When Tribbie launches Follow-Up ATK and triggers the Additional DMG from Tribbie's Zone, it further deals #1[i] instance(s) of Additional DMG.
1141515.desc_cn: 整场生效，对缇宝施放时，使缇宝造成的伤害无视敌方目标#2[i]%的防御力。缇宝施放追加攻击触发缇宝的结界的附加伤害时，会额外造成#1[i]次附加伤害。

1141516.name: Ode to Strife
1141516.desc: One-time effect. When used on Mydei, removes all Crowd Control debuffs inflicted on him. And if Mydei is in the "Vendetta" state, he automatically uses 1 instance of "Godslayer Be God" without consuming Charge. Mydei's CRIT DMG increases by #1[i]% during this attack. If the target gets defeated before the use, then it will target the newly arriving enemy targets instead. If Mydei is not in the "Vendetta" state, then advances Mydei's action by #2[i]%.
1141516.desc_cn: 单次生效，对万敌施放时解除万敌陷入的所有控制类负面状态，若万敌处于【血仇】状态，则使其自动施放1次不消耗充能的【弑神登神】，本次攻击中万敌的暴击伤害提高#1[i]%，若施放前目标被消灭则对新入场的敌方目标施放。若万敌不处于【血仇】状态，则使万敌行动提前#2[i]%。

1141517.name: Ode to Life and Death
1141517.desc: Effective for the entire battle. When used on Castorice, "Newbud" can overflow up to #3[i]%. When summoning Netherwing, consumes all overflowing "Newbud." For every 1% overflow amount consumed, increases the multiplier by #2[f2]% for the DMG dealt when this summoned Netherwing triggers the ability effect of its Talent "Wings Sweep the Ruins." If there are #6[i] enemy target(s) or fewer on the field when summoned, the DMG multiplier additionally increases by #5[f2]%.
1141517.desc_cn: 整场生效，对遐蝶施放时，【新蕊】可以溢出至#3[i]%。召唤死龙时会消耗所有溢出【新蕊】，每消耗1%溢出值，使本次召唤的死龙触发天赋【灼掠幽墟的晦翼】的技能效果时，造成的伤害倍率提高#2[f2]%，召唤时若场上敌方目标小于等于#6[i]名，伤害倍率额外提高#5[f2]%。

1141518.name: Ode to Reason
1141518.desc: One-time effect. When used on Anaxa, recovers #4[i] Skill Point(s) for allies and enables Anaxa to take action immediately. Skill has #1[i] more instances of DMG, lasting for 1 turn. The next time Anaxa uses Basic ATK or Skill, he gains "True Knowledge": All Erudition characters have their ATK increased by #3[i]% and their dealt Skill DMG increased by #2[i]%, lasting until the start of Anaxa's next turn.
1141518.desc_cn: 单次生效，对那刻夏施放时，为我方恢复#4[i]个战技点并使那刻夏立即行动，使其战技的伤害次数增加#1[i]次，持续1回合。那刻夏在下一次施放普攻、战技时获得【真知】：所有「智识」命途角色攻击力提高#3[i]%、造成的战技伤害提高#2[i]%，持续至下一个那刻夏回合开始时。

1141519.name: Ode to Sky
1141519.desc: When Demiurge uses Memosprite Skill, causes Hyacine to gain 2 stacks of "Ode to Sky." When used on Hyacine, regenerates #2[i] Energy for Hyacine. When Hyacine has "Ode to Sky" and is providing healing, additionally increases the amount to be included in the tally of Little Ica's Memosprite Skill by an amount equal to #1[i]% of the current healing amount. After Hyacine uses Skill/Ultimate, consumes 1 stack of "Ode to Sky."
1141519.desc_cn: 德谬歌施放忆灵技时，使风堇获得2层【献予「天空」之诗】。对风堇施放时，为风堇恢复#2[i]点能量。当风堇持有【献予「天空」之诗】并提供治疗时，计入小伊卡忆灵技的治疗数值额外提高，提高数值等同于本次治疗数值的#1[i]%。风堇施放战技/终结技后，消耗1层【献予「天空」之诗】。

1141520.name: Ode to Trickery
1141520.desc: Effective for the entire battle. When used on Cipher, increases the DMG dealt by Cipher by #1[i]%, decreases the DEF of the "Patron" by #2[i]% and decreases the DEF of all other enemy targets by #3[i]%.
1141520.desc_cn: 整场生效，对赛飞儿施放时，使赛飞儿造成的伤害提高#1[i]%，并使【老主顾】的防御力降低#2[i]%，【老主顾】以外的敌方目标的防御力降低#3[i]%。

1141521.name: Ode to Worldbearing
1141521.desc: Effective for the entire battle. After it is used on Phainon, Phainon gains #8[i] "Coreflame" as well as "Eternal Ignition" when Transforming. When Transforming, if "Coreflame" exceeds #5[i], for each point in excess, Khaslana's CRIT DMG increases by #6[i]%, up to a max increase of #7[i]%. While "Eternal Ignition" persists, increases Khaslana's CRIT Rate by #1[f1]%. After the extra turns are depleted, the Transformation does not end, and all of Khaslana's extra turns get refreshed and #9[i] "Scourge" is granted. At the start of extra turns, Khaslana consumes HP equal to #2[i]% of his current HP. After using an attack, deals #3[i] instances of Additional DMG, with each instance dealing Fire Additional DMG equal to #4[f1]% of Khaslana's ATK to one random enemy.
1141521.desc_cn: 整场生效，对白厄施放后，使白厄获得#8[i]点【火种】，且在变身时获得【永续的燃烧】，变身时若【火种】大于#5[i]点，每超出1点，卡厄斯兰那的暴击伤害提高#6[i]%，最多可提高#7[i]%。持有【永续的燃烧】时，卡厄斯兰那的暴击率提高#1[f1]%，在卡厄斯兰那的额外回合耗尽后不会结束变身、刷新全部卡厄斯兰那的额外回合并获得#9[i]点【毁伤】。额外回合开始时，卡厄斯兰那消耗等同于当前生命值#2[i]%的生命值。施放攻击后，造成#3[i]次附加伤害，每次伤害对敌方随机单体造成等同于卡厄斯兰那#4[f1]%攻击力的火属性附加伤害。

1141522.name: Ode to Ocean
1141522.desc: One-time effect. When used on Hysilens, Hysilens gains "Flowing Warmth." After Hysilens uses an attack, consumes "Flowing Warmth" and regenerates #4[i] Energy for this unit. In this battle, increases the DMG dealt by Hysilens by #1[i]%. After Hysilens uses Basic ATK/Skill to attack enemies, causes all the DoT currently applied on the attacked enemy targets to immediately produce DMG equal to #2[i]%/#3[i]% of the original DMG.
1141522.desc_cn: 单次生效，对海瑟音施放时，使海瑟音获得【暖流】。海瑟音施放攻击后消耗【暖流】为自身恢复#4[i]点能量。本场战斗中，海瑟音造成的伤害提高#1[i]%，施放普攻/战技攻击敌方目标后，使受到攻击的敌方目标当前承受的所有持续伤害立即产生相当于原伤害#2[i]%/#3[i]%的伤害。

1141523.name: Ode to Law
1141523.desc: Effective for the entire battle. After using on Cerydra, increases the CRIT DMG of the character with "Military Merit" by #1[i]%. After Coup de Main ends, Cerydra immediately gains #2[i] Charge.
1141523.desc_cn: 整场生效，对刻律德菈施放后，持有【军功】的角色暴击伤害提高#1[i]%，奇袭结束后，使刻律德菈获得#2[i]点充能。

1141524.name: Ode to Time
1141524.desc: Effective for the entire battle. After it is used on Evernight, increases the DMG dealt when Evey uses the Memosprite Skill "Dream, Dissolving, as Dew" by #1[i]%. After Evernight uses Skill/Ultimate, additionally gains #2[i] "Memoria." The CRIT DMG boost effect provided by the Skill is further increased by an amount equal to #3[i]% of Evernight's CRIT DMG.
1141524.desc_cn: 整场生效，对长夜月施放后，「长夜」施放忆灵技【迷梦，流失，如露】时造成的伤害提高#1[i]%，长夜月施放战技/终结技后，额外获得#2[i]点【忆质】。长夜月战技的暴击伤害提高效果额外提高，提高数值等同于长夜月暴击伤害的#3[i]%。

1141525.name: Ode to Earth
1141525.desc: When Demiurge uses Memosprite Skill, grants "Ode to Earth" to Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae, and enables the next #3[i] attack(s) of "Souldragon" to deal Additional DMG of the Bondmate's Type, equal to #4[i]% of the Bondmate's Shield Effect. When Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae holds "Ode to Earth," the "Bondmate" deals #1[f1]% increased DMG. When used on Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae, advances Souldragon's action by 100%. Souldragon's next action gains the enhancement effect of Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae's Ultimate and the Shield Effect provided by Souldragon is #5[i]% of its original Shield Effect. Does not consume the enhancement number of Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae's Ultimate.
1141525.desc_cn: 德谬歌施放忆灵技时，使丹恒•腾荒获得【献予「大地」之诗】，并使【龙灵】的下#3[i]次攻击造成等同于【同袍】护盾量#4[i]%的相应属性附加伤害。当丹恒•腾荒持有【献予「大地」之诗】时，【同袍】造成的伤害提高#1[f1]%。对丹恒•腾荒施放时，使龙灵行动提前100%，并使龙灵下一次行动时获得丹恒•腾荒终结技的强化效果、提供的护盾量为原护盾量的#5[i]%，不消耗丹恒•腾荒终结技的强化次数。

1141526.name: Ode to Ego
1141526.desc: For every 1 different teammate (i.e., excluding Demiurge) from whom Cyrene has gained "Recollection," additionally deals 1 instance of Ice DMG equal to #1[i]% of Demiurge's Max HP to one random enemy when Demiurge uses "Minuet of Blooms and Plumes." After Cyrene uses Ultimate or when Demiurge is summoned, Demiurge immediately gains 1 "Story." When "Story" reaches #2[i], Demiurge consumes all "Story" points to immediately gain 1 extra turn and automatically use "Minuet of Blooms and Plumes."
1141526.desc_cn: 昔涟每从1个除德谬歌以外不同的队友处获得【追忆】后，德谬歌施放【花与箭的舞曲】时额外对敌方随机单体造成1次等同于德谬歌#1[i]%生命上限的冰属性伤害。昔涟施放终结技后或德谬歌被召唤时，使德谬歌获得1点【故事】，当【故事】达到#2[i]点时，德谬歌消耗全部【故事】立即获得1个额外回合自动施放【花与箭的舞曲】。

1151201.name: Chirrup Quartet
1151201.desc: Deals Wind DMG equal to #2[f1]% of "Summer Songbirds'" Max HP to all enemies.
1151201.desc_cn: 对敌方全体造成等同于「晴空乐手」#2[f1]%生命上限的风属性伤害。

1151203.name: A Warble of Wings
1151203.desc: While in the "Fever" state, the "Summer Songbirds" and a countdown will appear on the Action Order. And the DMG dealt by Robin • Summeretto and "Summer Songbirds" increases by an amount equal to (#1[i]% + Vibes × #2[f1]%). When "Summer Songbirds'" turn starts, uses the Memosprite Skill. The countdown has an initial SPD of #9[i]. And when its turn starts, deducts #10[i]% of the current Vibes (minimum #6[i] points). When the Vibes reaches 0, the "Summer Songbirds" disappears and Robin • Summeretto exits the "Fever" state. While the "Summer Songbirds" is on the field, based on the number of its members present, increases the DMG taken by all enemies by #3[f1]%/#4[f1]%/#5[f1]% respectively.
1151203.desc_cn: 处于【Fever】状态时，「晴空乐手」和倒计时将出现在行动序列上，并使知更鸟•晴歌与自身造成的伤害提高（#1[i]%+气氛值*#2[f1]%）。「晴空乐手」回合开始时施放忆灵技。倒计时初始速度#9[i]点，回合开始时扣除#10[i]%的当前气氛值，至少扣除#6[i]点，当气氛值为零时，「晴空乐手」消失并使知更鸟•晴歌退出【Fever】状态。「晴空乐手」在场时，根据成员数量使敌方全体受到的伤害分别提高#3[f1]%/#4[f1]%/#5[f1]%。

1151205.name: Near the Sea's Heartbeat
1151205.desc: When the "Summer Songbirds" gets summoned, regenerates #1[i] Energy for Robin • Summeretto.
1151205.desc_cn: 「晴空乐手」被召唤时，为知更鸟•晴歌恢复#1[i]点能量。

1151206.name: Astride Summer's Nightwind
1151206.desc: When the "Summer Songbirds" disappears, Robin • Summeretto's action advances by #1[i]%.
1151206.desc_cn: 「晴空乐手」消失时，使知更鸟•晴歌行动提前#1[i]%。

1800701.name: Baddies! Trouble!
1800701.desc: Deals #2[i] instance(s) of DMG, with each instance dealing Ice DMG equal to #1[f1]% of Mem's ATK to one random enemy. At the end, deals Ice DMG equal to #3[i]% of Mem's ATK to all enemies.
1800701.desc_cn: 造成#2[i]次伤害，每次对敌方随机单体造成等同于迷迷#1[f1]%攻击力的冰属性伤害。最后对敌方全体造成等同于迷迷#3[i]%攻击力的冰属性伤害。

1800703.name: Friends! Together!
1800703.desc:
Increases all allies' CRIT DMG by an amount equal to #1[f1]% of Mem's CRIT DMG plus #2[f1]%.
If the Charge has yet to reach 100%, Mem automatically uses "Baddies! Trouble!" when taking action. When the Charge reaches 100%, Mem immediately takes action. In the next action, can select one ally and use "Lemme! Help You!".
1800703.desc_cn:
使我方全体的暴击伤害提高，提高数值等同于迷迷#1[f1]%暴击伤害+#2[f1]%。
若充能未达到100%，迷迷行动时自动施放【坏人！麻烦！】。充能达到100%时迷迷立即行动，下一次行动时能够选择我方单体并施放【我会！帮你！】。

1800705.name: Go, Mem, Go!
1800705.desc: When Mem is summoned, immediately gains #1[i]% Charge.
1800705.desc_cn: 迷迷被召唤时，立即获得#1[i]%充能。

1800706.name: No... Regrets
1800706.desc: When Mem disappears, Trailblazer's action advances by #1[i]%.
1800706.desc_cn: 迷迷消失时，使开拓者行动提前#1[i]%。

1800707.name: Lemme! Help You!
1800707.desc:
Advances the action of one designated ally by #3[i]% and grants them "Mem's Support," lasting for #2[i] turn(s).
For every 1 instance of DMG dealt by a target that has "Mem's Support," additionally deals 1 instance of True DMG equal to #1[i]% of the original DMG.
When using this ability on this unit, cannot trigger the action advance effect.
1800707.desc_cn:
使指定我方单体行动提前#3[i]%并附上【迷迷的声援】，持续#2[i]回合。
持有【迷迷的声援】的目标每造成1次伤害，都会再额外造成1次等同于原伤害#1[i]%的真实伤害。
当对自身施放该技能时，无法触发行动提前效果。
